name: Highball
one_liner: Runs Windows games on Apple Silicon and tells you if yours will work.

text.why: Tools that run Windows games on a Mac make you pick a Wine build yourself, and you only learn whether a game works after installing it. Highball sets up Wine, DXMT, D3DMetal and DXVK, connects a Steam or Epic library, and pulls per-game renderer verdicts and the anti-cheat blocklist from an open CC0 database before you download anything. App and CLI are GPL-3.0, the data is CC0, and the README rules out a paid tier. Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer only, and still in beta.
text.take: The real product is the CC0 compatibility database behind the app.
build: A personal check of Mac compatibility before buying a game
